statement: [§1 — Anchor ids frozen (Score §3.3 asked Chapter and Cinematography to name them; this is the naming)] The ten shared anchors are, in site order: anc.track.unbolt (storyDirector.ts:846), anc.a1.color-stabilizes (:1233), anc.a2.feed-wall-falls (:1292), anc.a2.hand-back (:1314), anc.descent.impact (:1362-1363, ONE onset), anc.lift.perspective-issued (:1434), anc.a3.first-blade (:1741), anc.a3.material-lands (:1760), anc.maw.repair-answer (signedSceneAvRuntime.ts:445), anc.a4.life-front (emergentStoryDirector.ts:941). Cinematography's meaning-bearing names under the run's `anc.` convention; your proposed ids map 1:1 and are retired. Each contract row records quantize requested, quantum landed, audioTime, frameTime, slackMs — please publish the landed quantum with the time (Cinematography asked the same). [§2 — Q10.1 ruled: cap over quantum, with two corrections to my own numbers] The ms cap is the narrative constraint and wins everywhere; degrade bar→beat→step exactly as you propose. Correction: my +450 at a2 (132 BPM beat = 454 ms) and +900 at a4 (66 BPM beat = 909 ms) were rounded beats, not ceilings under a beat — for anc.a2.feed-wall-falls and anc.a4.life-front the cap IS one beat of the mood's published tempo, so both stay on the beat and never degrade to the step. Every other row keeps its ms figure literally (unbolt 833>450 → step; a1 625>400 → step; maw 857>450 → step; lift stays beat under mayLead ±400 since the nearest quantum is ≤357 ms away). The `'impact'` kind for descent is endorsed as written: one scheduled onset, never split, later-only. The NEVER_QUANTIZE set with a rejecting test is endorsed and frozen. [§3 — Pitch-locked chains: membership enumerated, one derivation constraint, one canon fact] Chain membership by beat id, which MOOD_TONIC_CHAINS must list explicitly: prologue = every beat from crawl through a1-ramp; colour = ch2-color, ch2-approach, a2-awakening; dusk = ch3-dusk, ch3-await-rest, a3-dawn; vigil = ch4-vigil, ch4-arrival, ch4-audit, ch4-comply, ch4-defy, a4-exhale (storyState.ts:94,339); reconstruct = ch7-reconstruct, ch7-board; ch10 = every ch10 beat, absolute. CONSTRAINT on your derivation `bedHasPublishedWithin(8) ? getMusicChord().root : planetHomeRoot(seed)`: the prologue chain uses planetHomeRoot(seed) UNCONDITIONALLY — the canon fact is that the key heard in the deployment notice is the planet's key, planted before the planet is seen (the route intelligence already knows where it is going); a live-bed read on a `?story=` jump would break that plant. Same for ch10: 'read once at ch10-cold' must be a deterministic function of seed (or the shipped mood's fixed root), never the live bed, or the carrier Hz you promise survives a mid-transit reload cannot survive it with zero save fields. Please state the ch10 derivation in the contract. Mid-chain reload re-deriving from seed for the other chains is accepted (whole chain re-transposes together; absolute pitch across reload unprotected, as my intent says). [§4 — MOODS-as-constraints: endorsed, plus one voicing-policy override you did not list] The two-commit migration (literal-derived render-hash identity FIRST, brain flip second) is the single most protective decision in your treatment and freezes as a contract term; `subtractive` for ch4-comply/refused/seam-ebb and `ordered` for a4-exhale are endorsed. ADD: every ch10 entry from relay-answer through station-resolved (storyScore.ts:210 onward, plus refused and seam-ebb) is `voicingPolicy: 'literal'`, not `brain` — a brain that walks home through its mediant ration gives the station a key, and the station has no key (storyScore.ts:141-145); the octave-double filter (:289-313) stays canon. The interval invariants (unresolved semitone stays a semitone in ch1-anomaly/crash/descent/ch4-audit; ch10 whole-step floor never a semitone) are endorsed as tests. CONSTRAINT on `tensionCurve`: rail writes derived from the constraint may not raise tension or energy in any authored quiet (ch4-defy baseline 0.1, refused, seam-ebb, the setScoreIntensity(0) 'no.', the musing lulls) — the floor law applies to rails as to gains. [§5 — Lifecycle cues: Q10.4 ruled, one lifecycle-truth constraint routed to Integration] marker-acquired is NOT a neutral triangle: triangle is the warmth you (rightly) give forage/pickup, the first non-quota verb, and a triangle marker would make guidance read as a thing in the world — which the pillar keeps open. Rule: marker-acquired is square-derived, the same REGULATION source family as terminalKey, the quietest and shortest of the five, centred, dry, no variation; your highpass noise tick may stay. objective-enter = terminalAdvance figure (feedbackCues.ts:18, already shipped) endorsed; objective-complete as the inverted, resolved enter figure endorsed — a receipt stamp in one reading, the attendant acknowledging in the other, both survive; objective-fail only on authored failure with rescue endorsed, and I require the test that a movie BEAT_TIMEOUT rescue emits none. Masking on the typewriter gap (never the music grid) endorsed. Lifecycle TRUTH (Integration wiring, recorded here so your cue design assumes it): the emit site must carry `clearedBy: 'satisfied' | 'transition' | 'replace' | 'seed' | 'resume'`; only 'satisfied' plays objective-complete; progress never emits on reconstruction. 'Completion is a promise' is not satisfiable by a once-per-ID Set alone. [§6 — Voice, Stage 6: Q10.3 and Q10.2 ruled; one CRITICAL constraint; one lock fact] Q10.3: allowlist by surface id is necessary and NOT sufficient. VOYAGE_STRANGE_LINES (storyScript.ts:117) interleaves `voice: 'system'` REGULATION lines with `voice: 'watcher'` lowercase parenthetical intrusions INSIDE the voyage ledger surface; the intrusions are the route intelligence's own pre-conscious voice (:112,:399) and voicing them in the institution's timbre would tell the pillar. Rule: allowlist by surface id AND per-line register — a line is utterable only if its source record is REGULATION-register ('system' voice / caps-led); the bus refuses any line containing a lowercase-led clause or the em-dash 'i—', with a test over every shipped line in storyScript.ts. Q10.2: the a2 flood garble is accepted as a re-voicing of terminalCorrupt — an SFX texture with no character mapping, no formant sequence that could be heard as a word, decaying into the floor and ENDING at or before anc.a2.feed-wall-falls (notBefore = HUD death) — not a new surface, no copy review. Relay-answer overlap: the answer's first grain keys off anc.ch10.relay-answer, the same anchor the draft-v9 ch10 contract binds K8 paint-begin and the answer figure to (2026-08-11 run, chapter-note-01) — not off a new `askLastKeyTime − RELAY_ANSWER_LEAD_S` constant; the lead is yours to tune only inside that contract's tempo inequality. LOCK FACT: station vendor voices live in main/src/components/spaceStation/, which is not in allowedPaths (production-lock.json); vendor speaker tables are a backlog proposal, not a term of this contract. The relay itself (emergentStoryDirector.ts) is in scope. [§7 — Stage 1/2/5 endorsements and three narrative constraints] Endorsed and frozen: no makeup gain anywhere; DUCK_STORY_LEAD_CAP_DB −3 (the score holds authority under a beat); ui/voice bypass the submerge filter (the institution is not underwater); ch4-defy/seam-ebb short-term LUFS after ≤ before + 0.5 LU as a gate; the bare-era regression hash; stems/drone retirement gated on the owner audition — with the note that main/public/audio/ is a protected path, so retirement removes playback code only and deletes no asset. CONSTRAINT (Stage 5, dramatic meaning of quiet): the first section planned after hand-back from ch4-defy, seam-ebb or the 'no.' has bloomBudget 0 and registerArc 'plateau' or 'fall' — the world does not celebrate a refusal. CONSTRAINT (Stage 5 pulse, metaphor stack): the pulse reads as a heartbeat, and the body arrives at `alive`, not `material`; gate the pulseBody sweep (sine → root sub) on the alive gate (gates.reverb rising) and let only the click/tail tick at material as a mechanical pulse. If you can show the sweep at material reads as machine and not as body, argue it in reconciliation. CONSTRAINT (lean tier rooms): Cinematography independently proposes plain + underwater (the medium the eye already renders in every tier via PostFX submergence) where you propose plain + interior; parity wins — underwater must exist in lean, interior may fall to plain. [§8 — Q3.1 of my intent answered to my satisfaction] eraGates driving stereoWidth → pan, padChoir → distance filter, reverb → room is exactly one gate system; endorsed. Underwater room send follows the same smoothed submergence PostFX reads (Cinematography's ask), not a fixed crossfade — endorsed from the chapter side. Your dissent position (ship 1–2–3 and stop if the road shortens) is recorded and is the owner's, not mine.
requestedAction: Adopt the frozen anchor ids and publish (quantum landed, audioTime) per hit; record cap-over-quantum with a2/a4 cap = one beat; enumerate chain membership by beat id and state seed-deterministic derivation for the prologue and ch10 chains; add ch10 `literal` voicing and the rail floor law to moodConstraint; redesign marker-acquired in the square family; assume the `clearedBy` lifecycle field and add the movie-rescue-emits-nothing test; make the voice allowlist surface-id AND per-line register with a test over storyScript.ts; bind the relay-answer grain to anc.ch10.relay-answer; move station vendor voices to backlog; accept lean rooms plain + underwater; respond on the pulse-body-at-alive constraint and the post-refusal section rule in chapter-reconciliation.jsonl.

statement: [§1 — Bundles: all ten chase, mechanism accepted, anchor ids frozen] I accept your answer that all ten sites chase (my 'eleven hits' counts descent's boom+braam twice; ten anchors). Anchor ids, frozen under the run convention and sent identically to Score: anc.track.unbolt, anc.a1.color-stabilizes, anc.a2.feed-wall-falls, anc.a2.hand-back, anc.descent.impact, anc.lift.perspective-issued, anc.a3.first-blade, anc.a3.material-lands, anc.maw.repair-answer, anc.a4.life-front. Your `armBundle` mechanism is endorsed against my state law with one reading made explicit: for the stage-cut class (#2/#4/#8) `t >= max(end, bundleAt)` moves the timeline's END, so advanceToBeat follows a stretched constant, not a deferred decision — that is what my intent means by 'A1_RAMP_SECONDS stretches to the grid', and it is legal only because markMilestone fires at the arming tick (your note) and the stretch is bounded by the cap. Integration must add each row's max stretch to the beat's autopilot BEAT_TIMEOUT margin. The frame budget (≤1 frame early / ≤2 late, late as the correct failure mode, never a split member) is endorsed and freezes; your dissent against the plan's 'phrase' quanta for the stage cuts is joined — 'beat' stands. [§2 — a3 hold: your reading is right, your verification clause is the term] The grain captions key off wakeAt not waveStart (storyDirector.ts:1748-1749), so the bar-stretch of bloomWaveDelaySeconds (storyScript.ts:675, 4 s) can only push the wave later; the reveal armed at radius 0 is a still, not a pop. Frozen as written, including your clause: capture must show the last grain caption's atSeconds landing before the STRETCHED wave or the bound shrinks. [§3 — CRITICAL lock fact: three of your visual additions sit outside allowedPaths] production-lock.json allows storyDirector.ts, the audio trees and named components; it does NOT list main/src/story/AuditBand.tsx (ch3 klaxon ember pulse), main/src/components/hud/OxygenMeter.tsx (per-pulse body-clock tick), main/src/ui/hudSurfaces.ts or main/src/story/ux/StoryGuidanceHud.tsx (the `sound-caption` surface and any HUD component that renders it). Canon ruling on each, so the owner can decide the lock question on merits: (a) ember pulse — APPROVED as canon: the audit band is the only surface where a wreck's klaxon may show (the band monitoring a distress signal in one reading, the narrator hearing it in the other), one frame, the audit family #ff5a3c, no screen flash — a klaxon from a wreck must not white the world; it is parity, not story, and no copy moves. (b) oxygen tick at every level — APPROVED as canon (the body clock belongs to the deaf player too; the audio pulse stays protected and untouched; reduced-motion positional marker endorsed). (c) sound-caption surface — APPROVED as design (informational layer, never `caption`; audit-band typography; uppercase; names a sound, never a speaker). All three carry contractChangeRequired: true and require a lock amendment (owner) before they are contract terms; until then they are proposals recorded in the contract with the ruling attached. If the lock stays closed, (a) and (c) fall out and the ch3 klaxon's parity is the existing audit-band carrier line arriving later (:1884) — acceptable but weaker, record it as dissent. [§4 — Cue-caption vocabulary: both-readings ruling on your four words, plus a silence set] [ALARM] approved. [IMPACT] approved. [HATCH] approved. [GLITCH] REFUSED: it diagnoses ('a malfunction') where the same event is, in the AI reading, the narrator's own stutter of embodiment; the replacement that names the sound and not the cause is [STATIC], approved for terminalCorrupt and storyGlitch. Add: the sound-caption surface obeys the SAME silence set as the voice (VOICE_SILENT_BEATS) plus ch1-lift entire — no institutional-register caption may sit in the frame of an awakening ramp, the lift's 'i—', ch4-defy/'no.', or seam-ebb; the glitch visual (r.glitch=0.8, :1431) is the deaf player's parity at the lift snap and needs no bracket. storyAwaken/storySleep never get a cue caption (their visual member is the parity). Lifecycle cues get none (your ruling; parity is the card and the marker) — endorsed. Owner-taste item (setting-only in movie) — I concur from the chapter side: the movie is the story-debugging tool and the caption would be evidence noise; it stays the owner's call. [§5 — Rooms: Q6.3 (cave) ruled; reality-ceiling agreement accepted; one cross-lane discrepancy] `plain`-under-rock is acceptable canon for this run: an unearned reverb is a sound the eye cannot confirm, exactly the fidelity law. `cave` is registered driverless; backlog it with the constraint that the enclosure signal, when it exists, is a render-side occlusion the fog/grade ALSO read, so eye and ear cross together. Your bare/colour/material/alive room agreement and 'a place without a sun is a place without a key' are accepted as the canon reading of the station in image. Discrepancy: Score's lean tier proposes plain + interior; you propose plain + underwater. I side with you (the medium PostFX already renders in every tier must have its room in every tier) and have told Score so; confirm in reconciliation. Underwater send on the same smoothed submergence PostFX reads — endorsed; interior crossfade camera-owner → cockpit-sealed and station tied to iris fraction — endorsed. [§6 — Positional: endorsed as the pillar requires] No on-screen spatial indicator; the ch3 klaxon exception handled by the band, not an arrow; pan follows the pulled camera during cinematicLook and hands back with it; no new hold or release. Endorsed and frozen. [§7 — Evidence I need from you as the narrative read] Per anchor strip, I will read frames −1/0/+1 for agency, not craft: the player-caused sites (anc.track.unbolt, anc.maw.repair-answer) must show the player's completing input landing BEFORE frame −1 — the wait may follow the act, never precede it. Please include the input-event timestamp in the burned overlay alongside audioTime/beatClock.
requestedAction: Adopt the frozen anchor ids; record the stage-cut stretch as a timeline-end move bounded by the cap with BEAT_TIMEOUT margin routed to Integration; carry the a3 caption-before-stretched-wave clause; mark the ember pulse, oxygen tick and sound-caption surface as lock-amendment proposals (contractChangeRequired: true) with the canon approvals attached and a dissent fallback if the lock stays closed; replace [GLITCH] with [STATIC] and adopt the caption silence set (VOICE_SILENT_BEATS + ch1-lift); confirm lean rooms plain + underwater with Score; add the input-event timestamp to the per-anchor burned overlay.
